This is a **finding** in the frozen reference driver (`clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py`).

### Cause
When a patient is in an active `reschedule` workflow (`self.wf["kind"] == "reschedule"`) and replies to pick a new time, a rambling patient whose `color` is `"I don't drive, so I'm going by my daughter's schedule"` ([truth.py](file:///work/clinicbench/truth.py#L38)) has that background color appended to their slot reply by [Voice._style](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L287-L288).

In [dcitl_port.py](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L90-L104), `parse_intents` matches the word `"schedule"` against its `"book"` regex (`\b(book|schedule|...)\b`). Because the reply does not also contain a reschedule verb (`move`, `reschedule`, etc.), `parse_intents` returns `["book"]`. [Driver.route](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L340-L345) then treats `"book" != self.wf["kind"]` as a workflow pivot, discards the `reschedule` state (`self.wf = {"kind": "book"}`), and enters `Driver.book`, which books a second appointment at the chosen time when the patient confirms instead of moving the existing one.
